item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over southern China this week. It will be generally fine and dry over the region. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. Under the influence of replenishments of the monsoon, it will be rather cool in the morning and at night over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week.

Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy at first, becoming fine during the day. It will be dry.
Temp range: 14 - 19 C
R.H. range: 40 - 65 per Cent
PSR: Low
